title: Envelope
description: Every Skyhaul drone message, schema_version 1. The envelope is closed: no other top-level fields. The payload is validated against the schema for its type.

correlation_id.description: Commands: set by the sender. Replies and command-driven telemetry: copied from the command. Drone-initiated telemetry and ALERT: null.

schema_version.description: Version of the whole contract set.

payload.description: Type-specific body. Payloads are tolerant readers: unknown fields are ignored.
